title: Advanced strategies for the removal of venlafaxine from aqueous environments: a critical review of adsorption and advanced oxidation pathways
content:

This review compares adsorption and advanced oxidation pathways for removing venlafaxine from water, highlighting mechanisms, catalyst design, and sustainability in modern wastewater treatment.
